dataFlows.detail: User baat -> brain reply; history chat memory se milti hai.
Plan steps -> PlannerTools registry -> B3 clients / ProjectStore.
Editor text -> encrypted project files (device par hi).
Deploy se pehle files ka text-only scan; critical security par deploy rukta hai.
